title: BIDMC PPG and Respiration — recording 01
description: Actual de-identified hospital-monitor numerics from a critically ill patient during care at Beth Israel Deaconess Medical Center, Boston, USA. This terrestrial clinical recording demonstrates plotting of real measurements. It is not astronaut data, a healthy reference population, or evidence validating this application for spaceflight.
license: Open Data Commons Attribution License v1.0 (ODC-By 1.0)
subject: De-identified BIDMC recording 01; critically ill hospital patient
attribution: Pimentel, M.A.F., Johnson, A.E.W., Charlton, P.H., and Clifton, D.A. BIDMC PPG and Respiration Dataset (version 1.0.0), PhysioNet, 2018. https://doi.org/10.13026/C2208R. Original study: Pimentel et al., Towards a Robust Estimation of Respiratory Rate from Pulse Oximeters, IEEE TBME 64(8):1914–1923, doi:10.1109/TBME.2016.2613124.
transformation: Original CSV retained alongside this JSON. All 481 rows mapped without filtering, interpolation, resampling, or synthetic values; column names normalized. Original NaN values represented as JSON null (13 oxygen and 13 pulse samples). Descriptive statistics calculated from nonmissing values.
limitations: Eight-minute single-patient recording; cannot establish healthy or astronaut-specific normal ranges.
Monitor-derived numbers can contain measurement artefacts.
No spaceflight exposure or astronaut identity is represented.

spaceflightContext.label: Five NASA human-spaceflight hazards
spaceflightContext.detail: Space radiation; isolation and confinement; distance from Earth; gravity fields; hostile/closed environments.

spaceflightContext.label: Reported bone-density loss
spaceflightContext.detail: NASA reports this average loss in weight-bearing bones during four-to-six-month missions; this is population context, not an individual prediction.

spaceflightContext.label: Inspiration4 in-flight mean sleep
spaceflightContext.detail: Published mean for the four-person short-duration Inspiration4 crew; not a long-duration mission baseline.

spaceflightContext.label: Public human spaceflight study
spaceflightContext.detail: SpaceX Inspiration4 Blood Serum Metabolic Panel and Immune/Cardiac Cytokine Arrays. Separate research reference; its participant data are not used in this chart.
